release_notes:
• New look: a cleaner, more consistent design across the whole app, and every text now meets accessibility contrast (WCAG AA) in both light and dark mode.
  • Dark mode is readable everywhere: panels, tables, search translations, checklists, risk-of-bias tools, GRADE and chat no longer show light text on light boxes.
  • Coloured buttons, labels, links and table page numbers are easier to read, and keep their colour in dark mode.
  • Importing .ris files keeps accents and special characters intact.
  • Library can fill in missing DOI, authors, journal and year for your records.
  • Reader notes can be exported to Word from the Library too.
  • The update notice always includes a download button.
  • Backups: the automatic backup now runs once when Nexus SR starts, not every time you reload the page, and old backups no longer leave extra files behind.
  • The Boost Pack is now £19 (same 290 AI operations).
